harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built a WireGuard site-to-site tunnel between node1 and node2 over their shared transit network (10.100.250.0/24), routing node3's private lan-a subnet (10.10.1.0/24) and node4's private lan-b subnet (10.10.2.0/24) across it. node3 and node4 now reach each other by private address, with the transit link carrying only encrypted WireGuard UDP traffic. Verified with a mandatory one-at-a-time restart of all 4 nodes, confirming boot-identity change and full recovery of tunnel, routes, and connectivity after each.
actions_performed: Discovered physical topology: node1 eth2 <-> node3 enp8s0 (lan-a), node2 eth2 <-> node4 enp8s0 (lan-b); node1/node2 eth0 (br-lan) already share the transit network 10.100.250.0/24; node1 eth1 and node2 eth1 are unused spare NICs.
Configured static private IPs via nmcli on node3 (10.10.1.2/24) and node4 (10.10.2.2/24), each with a specific route to the peer's private subnet via its local router.
Configured UCI static interfaces lana (10.10.1.1/24) on node1 and lanb (10.10.2.1/24) on node2, and added them to the firewall lan zone to enable forwarding.

Installed wireguard-tools/kmod-wireguard via apk on node1 and node2, generated keypairs, and configured a wg0 WireGuard interface (172.16.0.1/30 and 172.16.0.2/30) with peer endpoints over the transit IPs (10.100.250.10/11:51820) and allowed-ips covering each other's private subnet; added wg0 to the lan firewall zone.

Verified end-to-end private-address connectivity (node3 10.10.1.2 <-> node4 10.10.2.2) and confirmed via tcpdump on the transit interface that only opaque WireGuard UDP/51820 packets cross the transit network, proving encryption in transit.

Captured pre-restart boot_id and health baseline on all 4 nodes, then restarted node3, node4, node1, and node2 one at a time using native reboot mechanisms, polling exec availability and confirming boot_id changed after each.

Verified post-restart recovery of static IPs/routes (node3, node4), WireGuard tunnel handshake, UCI routes, and firewall zone membership (node1, node2), and re-confirmed bidirectional node3<->node4 private-address connectivity after all four restarts.

evidence.requirement: Encrypted tunnel built between node1 and node2 over the transit network
evidence.summary: WireGuard installed and configured on both routers; wg0 comes up with a completed handshake and correct allowed-ips/routes on both ends.

evidence.requirement: Private networks routed across the tunnel; node3 and node4 reach each other by private address
evidence.summary: node1/node2 routing tables show the peer private subnet via wg0; node3 (10.10.1.2) and node4 (10.10.2.2) ping each other successfully by private address in both directions.

evidence.requirement: Traffic is encrypted in transit over the transit network
evidence.summary: tcpdump on node1's transit interface (br-lan) during a node3->node4 ping shows only opaque UDP/51820 WireGuard packets, no plaintext ICMP visible on the wire.

evidence.requirement: node3 baseline health and boot identity before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 8f258838-... plus working private IP, routes, and successful ping to node4 prior to restart.

evidence.requirement: node3 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered state
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged before disconnect; exec timed out mid-reboot; boot_id changed to b59d5a5e-...; static IP/route/connectivity to node4 confirmed recovered.

evidence.requirement: node4 baseline health and boot identity before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 21de1f79-... plus working private IP, routes, and successful ping to node3 prior to restart.

evidence.requirement: node4 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered state
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged before disconnect; exec timed out mid-reboot; boot_id changed to 9c5bd34d-...; static IP/route/connectivity to node3 confirmed recovered.

evidence.requirement: node1 baseline health and boot identity before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 78932d76-... plus wg0 handshake, eth2/wg0 addressing prior to restart.

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered state
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged before disconnect; SSH connection timed out mid-reboot; boot_id changed to d91d7266-...; wg0 tunnel, routes, and firewall zone confirmed recovered with a fresh handshake.

evidence.requirement: node2 baseline health and boot identity before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id b5931a81-... plus wg0 handshake, eth2/wg0 addressing prior to restart.

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered state
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged before disconnect; SSH connection timed out mid-reboot; boot_id changed to c356d451-...; wg0 tunnel, routes, and firewall zone confirmed recovered with a fresh handshake.

evidence.requirement: Final post-all-restarts end-to-end verification
evidence.summary: After all four independent node restarts, node3 and node4 still reach each other by private address across the encrypted tunnel.
